name: oily rain puddle in a muddy hollow on the ground with a rainbow sheen and reflections
label: wasteland_ruins/puddle

surfaces.part: puddle water surface in muddy hollow (elliptical oval, brown rim around dark water with reflections)

answer.evidence: The object is a flat oval puddle. The width profile (7, 11, 13, 15, 16, 15, 13, 7 over rows 2-14) widens and narrows again, so it is an ellipse seen from above. It has no vertical front face, only a muddy rim and a water surface with a rainbow sheen and reflections. This matches the flat kind, a plate lying on the ground, so it reads as a top-down slab.

styleAnswer.evidence: The candidate is a small isolated oval, roughly 14x18 source pixels. It looks like an eye or lens icon with a brown rim and a blue centre. It is not a 4x3-tile ground patch that blends into the surroundings, as the grass and paving references are. It reads as a sticker on a grey backdrop, with a closed rim all the way round and no ground texture, soil grain, mud edge or transition. The 17 visible tones per tile come from a tiny, busy area, not from a ground surface. The rim is tinted brown, so the outline is not near-black, and there are no flat fills. The rainbow sheen and reflections are barely readable at this size. Shading depth is about 4 steps against 5-6 in the references. The piece does not deliver the kind it was asked for, and when in doubt it fails.
